notes.title: London Games Festival!
notes.content:
With 165 gaming awards stretching across the Arkham-verse, WB Games is proud to celebrate Rocksteady Studios' 20 years of gaming success with amazing savings in the London Games Festival! 

London Games Festival Sale Page

London is one of the most diverse, vibrant and creative cities on the planet. Its games and interactive entertainment sector is no different, representing a true convergence of talent, art, creativity and culture.

Games London has one mission: to make London the games capital of the world.

They do this with a year-round program of support for local businesses, engagement with investors and funders via inbound and outbound trade missions, and delivery of the UK's biggest games event.

In celebration of the 2025 London Games Festival, also the event's 10th anniversary, Fireshine Games are delighted to be hosting this event on Steam. Check out the sale page for big savings on some of the incredible titles that London based developers & publishers have worked on, and discover a variety of releases to look out for over the coming year!

notes.title: Bruce Wayne's Birthday Sale!
notes.content:
In honor of Bruce Wayne's birthday, WB Games is offering savings of up to 90% on these great DC Comics-themed games!  

SUICIDE SQUAD
From Rocksteady Studios, the creators of the Batman Arkham series, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is a genre-defying third-person action shooter where the ultimate band of misfits must do the impossible to save the world: Kill the Justice League.

BATMAN: ARKHAM SERIES
Become Batman in this best-selling, award-winning action-adventure trilogy! From deep storylines, to fun gameplay, classic DC super-villains and top voice talent, Arkham Asylum, Arkham City and Arkham Knight have it all!

GOTHAM KNIGHTS
Gotham Knights is an open-world, action RPG set in the most dynamic and interactive Gotham City yet. Patrol Gotham's five distinct boroughs in solo or in co-op and drop in on criminal activity wherever you find it. Your legacy begins now. Step into the Knight.

INJUSTICE 1 and 2
Developers of the best-selling and critically acclaimed MORTAL KOMBAT franchise, NetherRealm Studios brings unrivaled storytelling, robust content, and best-in-class fighting mechanics to the DC Universe in Injustice Gods Among Us and Injustice 2.

LEGO BATMAN SERIES 
Batman fans of all ages will enjoy fun and original storylines in this best-selling series filled with classic LEGO videogame action and humor as players fight to put the villains back behind bars.

LEGO DC SUPER-VILLAINS
Embark on a LEGO open-world adventure by becoming the best villain the universe has seen in LEGO DC Super-Villains. For the first time, a LEGO game gives you the ability to play as a super-villain, unleashing mischievous antics and wreak havoc in an action-packed, hilarious story written in collaboration with DC Comics.

SCRIBBLENAUTS UNMASKED
In Scribblenauts Unmasked: A DC Comics Adventure, Maxwell unites with Batman, Superman and the rest of The Justice League to restore order to the DC Comics Universe. Challenge your imagination as you battle the mightiest villains in an exciting, action-filled adventure through GOTHAM CITY, METROPOLIS, ATLANTIS and other iconic locales from the DC Comics Universe.
